parts.title: The Time Chamber
points: A hub room ringed by twelve Legacy Portals, each leading to a classic dungeon rebuilt one for one — same sprites, same monsters, same loot.
Pirate Cave, Forest Maze, Spider Den, Sprite World, Abyss of Demons, Undead Lair, Deadwater Docks, Crawling Depths, Woodland Labyrinth, Shaitan's Lair, Lair of Draconis, The Shatters.
The portal at twelve o'clock is the gentlest and they get harder clockwise. They hit as hard as they used to.
The Keyper appears at 33% and 66% of each realm's completion, and he is the way in.

parts.title: Six new encounters, thirteen new whites
points: The realm rework left some biomes short of encounters — Risen Hell had only the Skull Shrine, and not exclusively. These fill the gaps, and every class now has an event white of its own.

Artificial Slop in the Haunted Hallows, Cold Soul in the Risen Hell, Towering Perfection in the Sprite Forest, Man-eating Barnacle in the Coral Reefs, Stygian Mirror in the Risen Hell, Cube Deity in the Deep Sea Abyss.

Shifting Shroud, Cold Front, Babel Blocks, Barnacle Shell, Obsidian Lyre, Rectangular Prism, Wrathful Conduit, Rift Rippers, Scary Stories, General's Arsenal, Fossilized Skull, Skeletal Sigilpede, Ravenous Wand.
Ray Katana was reworked into something worth its rarity: it now fires a laser on hit, gaining projectiles with your defense.
Skull Shrine is now exclusive to the Risen Hell, Cube God to the Sprite Forest, and the Sprite Forest finally has conveyors.

parts.title: Venerable equipment
points: Existing gear rebuilt and improved, designed as a set: the bonus lands once a weapon, an armour and a ring are all worn. No ability item is part of it.
Weapons — Venerable Ancient Stone Sword, Spirit Dagger, Doom Bow, Staff of the Crystal Serpent, Crystal Wand, Doku no Ken.
Armour — Venerable Resurrected Warrior's Armor, Coral Silk Armor, Robe of the Mad Scientist.
Rings — Venerable Ring of the Pyramid, of the Nile, of the Sphinx. Combine the three in the Forge for the Decades Chronicle.

parts.title: Timekeeper Mystic
points: A UT set reskin marking the Mystic's rework: Staff of Rich History, Entrancing Hourglass, Traditional Blouse, Bronze Pocketwatch.
Collect all four and you can transform into the Timekeeper Mystic. It comes as a mini-skin too.
Fourteen shards feed the set; missions dedicated to the Mystic pay them out, and a full set exchanges for a chest you choose from.

parts.title: Missions and campaigns
points: A new mission tree, The Forgotten Legacy, runs the whole event: missions for the Mystic set, for the legacy dungeons, for each new encounter's white, and for the emotes.
A free campaign, Relics of the Past, runs five weeks. Forgotten Relics are scattered through the realm and its dungeons; right-click them in your inventory. Thirty stack to a slot.
Retrowinds tokens now come only from missions — no longer from dungeons or the Battle Pass — and missions pay more of them to compensate. Twenty of a kind buy a Selection Chest.
Six new emotes are mission rewards: Dancing Cubes, Load of Barnacles, Goofy Slop, Stygian Hand Mirror, Puzzled Deity, Very Cold Soul.
Celestial quests refresh weekly, and the season 3 to 6 quests are gone. Sixty Celestial Stones buy the new Wizard skin.

parts.title: Battle Pass — The Old Ways
points: Runs 1 September to 6 October. New skins for the Bard and the Knight.
Three old collections can be finished at last, each gaining its Druid: Antinomy, Syndicate Henchman, Kingdom.

parts.title: Weekly rotation
points: Week 1 — Crawling Depths and Ice Citadel, then Battle for the Nexus.
Week 2 — Woodland Labyrinth and The Shatters, then Mad God Mayhem.
Week 3 — Deadwater Docks and Lost Halls, then Trials of Cronus.
Week 4 — Parasite Chamber and Kogbold Steamwork, then Hidden Interregnum.
Week 5 — Lair of Shaitan and Moonlight Village, then Hidden Interregnum, and Oryx's Sanctuary on loot and XP boost.
Breaking the event chest opens the special dungeon 33% of the time in Adept dungeons, 66% in Veteran, always in Expert.
Oryx's Sanctuary stands open from 29 September.

parts.title: Changed, not added
points: The Crucible was rebuilt after the season's feedback: +10 DEF, +5 ATT, +5 DEX; shots over 15 damage carry a 30% chance of Exposed for 3 seconds on a 4 second cooldown; +20% loot, +15% BXP, +20% XP.
Trials of Cronus is a boss rush now — minion waves gone, two bosses to choose from each round instead of three, and every boss given a balance pass. It expects 6/8.
Round order — Sandstone Titan or Fountain Spirit, Ruthven or Corruption Phantom, Davy Jones or Thessal, Heroic Septavius or Infernal Malphas, then the Perfected Cube God.

Retrowinds gear drops at guaranteed Rare rarity. The weapon engraving calls lightning for 500 on player shoot and adds dexterity worth 9% of bonus speed; the armour grants 9 dexterity for 9 seconds when hit, on an 18 second cooldown, and +3 defense.

Thirteen biome shinies: Adventurer's Scarf, Torrential Staff, Celestial Recurve, Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy, Pirate's Artillery, Skull of Restless Souls, Doom's Emblem, Cavalry Lance, Cloak of the Deep, Evolutionary Records, Pollen Incendiary, Bloodbath Blade, Runes of Knowledge.

parts.title: Leaderboards
points: Two boards for the Time Chamber: one for completions and tenacity, one for speed. The twelve legacy dungeons award points by how fast you clear them and how hard they are.
Weeks 1 to 3 pay a Collection Chest and utility items at the top 30%, dust and quest chests at 15%, stat candy at 5%.
Week 4 adds sulphur at 15% and the Decades Chronicle at 5%. Week 5 pays a Season Vault Unlocker and a Seasonal Apple at 5%, after the season closes.
One skin a week for weeks 1 to 4, all four needed for the Master of All Elements quest: Air Elemental Paladin, Earth Elemental Knight, Water Elemental Summoner, Fire Elemental Sorcerer.

notes.title: Month of the Mad God
notes.subtitle: Season 30, Part 2 — Time Chamber
notes.lede: Ten years since Oryx took the realm, and the anniversary is the update. A hub of twelve portals leads to classic dungeons rebuilt as they were; six new encounters fill the biomes that had none; and an event runs five weeks on top of it.

added.description: Even far from his throne, this diminutive king has lost none of his royal pride. He follows his chosen adventurer with his crown held high, expecting every command to be obeyed.\n\nUnlocks the Old King Pet Skin of the Humanoid family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Despite being only a miniature likeness of Archdemon Malphas, this floating head has inherited all of his fiery temper. It follows close behind, glaring at anything foolish enough to cross its path.\n\nUnlocks the Malphas Head Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

This dapper little tortoise wears a top hat and monocle. Isn't that just adorable? 

Sprite Credits: BGJoe

Unlocks Fancy Turtle Skin of the Aquatic family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!
A terrifying diver's spooky ghost...or three Kogbolds trying to frighten people away from an underwater gold mine. One or the other.\n\nSkin Class: Wizard
An astral knight whose origin seems to be far across the star.\n\nSkin Class: Knight
Through their enchanted music, this bard brings harmony from the far reaches of the cosmos.\n\nSkin Class: Bard

This Druid’s lifespan stretches across time, their roots intertwined with the Realm. They possess knowledge of history unknown to many, thanks to the enchanted trees that have endured within the Realm for centuries.\n\nSkin Class: Druid

Days turned into years as this wizard dedicated their entire life to studying the art of time. Luckily, they lived long enough to ascend and gain a grasp of its inner workings. Now gifted with enough time, they can continue their research and further understand the fabric of time itself.\n\nSkin Class: Wizard
Customize your Mystic with the Mini Timekeeper Mystic Skin.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic

changed.description: This lightwave blade is carefully attuned to madness harmonics in a revolutionary attempt to remotely blast any region with the fury of the F.E.R.A.L.'s energy attack.

added.description: This elderwood staff blows targets away with gusts of yore.
A legendary pair of blades capable of tearing holes in the fabric of reality.
A writhing severed appendage capable of channeling dark, eldritch energies.
Guilded weapons befitting one of Oryx's elites. Few could wield such weapons effectively, and even fewer in tandem.
Her success in creating an unbreakable bow came at a terrible cost.
No mortal can fire this dreaded bow without resting in between shots. It requires tremendous skill to wield.
A slow but powerful sword that is a relic of a long forgotten age.

added.id: Venerable Staff of the Crystal Serpent
added.description: An ancient staff used both for sacrifice and communion with the gods.
A dagger that was condemned to Davy Jones' Locker.
A sound almost like a wind chime emanates softly from this wand.
Stuck in the maw of the Son of Arachna, this katana is coated in the creature's poisonous venom. In the hands of the right person, this is a truly deadly weapon.
A dagger fashioned from the fang of an enormous spider.
No mortal can fire this dreaded bow without resting in between shots. It requires tremendous skill to wield.
Once the most powerful staff in existence; a crack in its frame has rendered it incapable of focusing fire. It remains uniquely deadly.
Used only by the pirates who would make themselves kings, this cutlass is said to be cursed as each Pirate King seems to be killed rather unexpectedly.
Stuck in the maw of the Son of Arachna, this Katana is coated in the creature's poisonous venom. In the hands of the right person, this is a truly deadly weapon.
Fashioned from the finest logs found within the Woodland Labyrinths, this bow uses sharp leaves instead of conventional arrows. Such lightweight ammunition allows for quick movement.
An ancient weapon imbued with the power of the cosmos.
A swift and hungry blade that is never satisfied with just one kill.

A majestic trident adorned with enchanted coral formations that enables command of the tides. Once wielded by King Alexander in his conquest of the oceans, its power has since faded with each passing moon from natural weathering.

A wondrous bow of heavenly origin, harnessing Daevic magic to bend and concentrate light into tangible projectiles. At the point where these beams intersect, a dazzling burst of celestial brilliance radiates.
Although cannons were once typically associated with naval warfare, many pirates now regard Bilgewater's application of them in land-based combat as revolutionary.

A malevolent katana infested with parasitic organisms. The ravenous symbiotes instills in its user a thirst for blood, which grows as it drinks from the life force of its wielder and their foes alike.

changed.description: A great katana charged with the power of the sun itself.

added.description: A once-fractured hourglass enchanted and repurposed to ensnare victims in a noxious nostalgia.
The fossilized skull of a kaiju even older and more powerful than the one that roams the Carboniferous.
A rectangular prism cut to perfection with impossibly accurate 90 degree angles.
A finely crafted instrument capable of producing a heavenly sound from the depths.
A living sigil that empowers the host by merging with their spine.
A cursed book of terrifying legends, myths, and stories from across the realm.
A scepter wielded by the daughter to channel her wrath into rapid, explosive bursts of elemental energy.
An enchanted cloak crafted by an ancient guild of timeshifter thieves.
This skull glows with the stolen soul of a phoenix trapped in the skull many years ago by Shaitan.

added.id: Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy Shiny
added.description: A sinister twist on the scarecrow's intended use. Totalia bewitched these cursed figures with an uncanny allure to enthral victims into their untimely demise.

An unnaturally pristine skull adorned with a crown of thorns. Various parts of this once holy figure continue to be worshipped as sacred relics post-mortem as they bestow graces and miracles through the traces of divine power abiding within.

An accursed sigil that beckons to one's inner demons. Unholy paladins can unleash their dormant latent potential by forming a pact with an otherworldly force through a tribute of their own flesh and blood.

A resplendent, gilded lance once wielded by a legendary horseback rider of yore during the great Draconic Cataclysm. Its formidable reach could slay monstrous dragons with seemingly impenetrable bodies by impaling their deeply buried hearts.
An enchanting cloak that conceals its wearer in a veil of iridescent bubbles. The shimmering cascade of bubbles serves as the only lifeline within the sea's deepest hadal trenches.

An ancient volume recording ancestral lineages dating as far back as the Primal Era. Infused with the essence of druidic magic, it grants the power to delve into nature's eternal transformation, morphing its caster into formidable creatures.

A diabolical fusion of magic and chemical warfare engineered by Dr. Terrible in his effort to subjugate the Nest. When unleashed, it triggers a cataclysmic chain reaction between the charged volatile pollen that engulfs the air in a blinding and roaring inferno.

A stone slab adorned with enigmatic symbols, harkening to an era of ancient technology still shrouded in obscurity. These same inscrutable runes are found etched on surfaces within the Tundra, beckoning those who dare to decipher their secrets.

changed.description: A seal granting the user access to other dimensions, though the means by which this is accomplished are unknown.
A pair of horns adorning a nightmatter-weave band. Allows one to mimic the full combat abilities of chief beisa

added.description: High-necked cotton garbs reminiscent of a simpler time.
A heavily plated armor fashioned from the shell of a very vicious barnacle.
A piece of the Artificial Slop in a state of constant change, never holding the same form for more than a moment.
A worn and battered suit of armor embedded with a mystic gem that flows with magical strength.

added.id: Venerable Robe of the Mad Scientist
added.description: A well-worn robe used for Science!
Mermaid-made armor woven from unbreakable coral threads.
Light armor crafted from the hard-as-steel leafy scales of a Leaf Dragon.
A magic robe woven from enchanted threads of water harvested from a great Water Dragon's body.
Battle armor made from Fire Dragon scales, one of the strongest substances this world has ever seen.

changed.description: A beautiful set of ornate ceremonial robes, filled with the energy of benevolent spirits from long ago.

added.description: The hands on this watch move quicker the longer you look away.
Although the Towering Perfection has been toppled, latent potential remains.
The malachite stone makes you feel at peace with the land.
The azure stone makes you feel ready for any situation.
The dolomite stone makes you feel able to stand against anything.
An etched starmatter gem atop a gilded band, commemorating the past 10 years of the Heroes of the Nexus' fight against the forces of Oryx.
A ring made from the eye of the Snake Queen.
A ring crafted from the faceted eye of an enormous spider.
An eerie reminder of what lays in the depths of the Shatters.
An odd stone, emanating a dark and mysterious energy.
Wearing it makes you feel particularly strong.
A faithful and comfortable scarf that has witnessed countless journeys. Imbued with a protective enchantment, it allows its wearer to gracefully weave through perilous situations.

changed.description: Coral from the depths of the ocean which has formed into a natural ring. Painful to put on and take off, but very rare and therefore desirable.
